title: Decide and build a foreign-adapter registration mechanism (entry point, dotted-path flag or manifest field) once a second real adapter exists
notes: builds systems under test from `ADAPTERS`, a hard-coded dict in
`membench/build_adapter.py`, so a third party reaches the harness only by
forking or patching that file. This is deferred rather than overlooked: what
the mechanism should be — an entry point, a dotted-path flag, a manifest
field — determines what the manifest can record about an adapter's identity,
and that is worth deciding with two real adapters in hand rather than one.
The README says plainly that this is the state today.

2026-11-24 audit: still not done. ADAPTERS in membench/build_adapter.py:9 is still a one-entry hard-coded dict (baseline_fts5) and cli.py:67 validates against it; no entry-point or dotted-path option in pyproject.toml or cli.py; README L91-95 still documents it as deferred. Left: owner decision on mechanism once a second adapter exists, then implement. Next: add a second adapter, then pick mechanism.
